full_prompt_en: A square detailed landscape painting looks down into a green river valley containing stone cottages, garden trees, and a small arched bridge beneath towering white clouds. The upper third is divided between a turquoise-gray sky and a mass of billowing cream cloud whose shaded folds give it sculptural depth. Beneath it, rounded hills extend across the horizon in alternating fields of pale yellow-green, olive, rust brown, and dense dark woodland. A winding line of trees separates several distant parcels. In the middle of the frame, one steep-roofed cottage nestles among rounded foliage on a raised patch of ground; a second larger stone house stands lower and closer to the viewer. Their warm brown walls and muted red roofs are broken by small dark windows, but vegetation partly conceals both buildings. Curving paths thread through planted gardens, shrubs, and small trees from the lower left toward the houses. On the right, a river descends from the middle distance through a narrow rocky channel. A single low stone bridge arches across it near the lower-right third, while bright water flashes beneath the arch and among darker foreground stones. Masses of trees frame the left edge and cluster around the buildings, shifting from almost black green to sunlit sage and moss. The foreground is rich with short, precise marks describing leaves, grasses, and uneven stone; the far hills use smoother broad patches. Strong daylight from above-left illuminates fields and cloud tops, and the deep tree canopies cast substantial green-black shadow. There are no prominent people or readable words. The overall composition layers cultivated rolling color bands above a densely textured river garden, using winding paths and water to lead the eye through a bright, orderly countryside.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形细节丰富的风景画俯瞰一处绿色河谷，其中有石砌村舍、庭园树木和一座小拱桥，上方耸起巨大的白云。上方三分之一由青灰天空与翻卷的奶油色云团分占，云层阴影褶皱带来雕塑般的体积。云下，圆缓丘陵沿地平线展开，浅黄绿、橄榄色、铁锈棕和浓重深色林带交替出现。一条蜿蜒树列分开几块远处田地。画面中央，一座陡坡屋顶村舍藏在高地的圆形绿荫之间；更大一座石屋立在较低、离观者更近的位置。暖棕墙面与低调红色屋顶被小深窗打断，但植物部分遮住两座房屋。弯曲小路穿过种植整齐的花园、灌木和小树，从左下向房屋延伸。右侧，一条河从中距离沿狭窄岩石水道流下。单孔低矮石桥在右下三分之一区域跨过水面，明亮流水在桥洞和更深的前景石头之间闪动。树丛框住左边缘，也围住房屋，色彩从近黑绿转为受光的鼠尾草绿和苔绿。前景以短而精确的笔迹刻画树叶、草与不平的石面，远丘则采用更平滑宽阔的色块。来自左上方的强日光照亮田地和云顶，浓密树冠投下厚重绿黑影子。画面没有显眼的人物或可读文字。整体构图把人工耕作般的起伏色带叠在肌理密集的河边花园之上，以蜿蜒道路和流水引导视线穿过明亮有序的乡野。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a detailed naturalistic surface organized into layered bands of cultivated color and densely worked near texture. Fresh yellow-green and sage areas alternate with olive, rust, dark forest green, and cool blue-gray, creating a patterned but spatially convincing field. Rounded masses carry many tiny leaf-like strokes, while distant expanses smooth into broad controlled patches. Bright overhead daylight separates sunlit planes from substantial dark recesses and gives pale upper forms sculptural highlights. Curving linear routes link the lower detailed area to calmer middle bands and a high atmospheric opening. Edges remain legible even amid abundant detail, with foliage softening transitions between built shapes and open color. The overall effect is lush, orderly, and expansive, with careful texture and strong light holding the complexity together.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有细致的自然主义表面，组织为层叠的田园色带和笔迹密集的近处肌理。清亮黄绿与鼠尾草绿同橄榄色、铁锈色、深林绿及冷蓝灰交替，形成有图案感却有可信空间的色域。圆润大形带大量细小树叶般笔触，远处开阔面则平滑成宽阔而受控的色块。明亮顶光把受光平面与厚重暗凹处分开，并赋予上方浅色形体雕塑般高光。弯曲线性路径将下方细节区域与较平静的中部色带及高处大气开口连接。即使细节丰盛，边缘仍能辨认，枝叶则柔化结构形与开阔色域的过渡。整体效果繁茂、有序而开阔，由细密肌理和强光共同维持复杂画面的整体性。
theme_en: A river valley with cottages, a stone bridge, and patterned green hills
theme_zh: 有村舍、石桥与拼布绿丘的河谷
name: James McIntosh Patrick
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
